tokens.name: cream-100
tokens.usage: Page ground for every screen. Text on it: ink or ink-soft.

tokens.name: cream-200
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: HUD bar, progress tracks, empty podium steps.

tokens.name: cream-300
tokens.usage: Hairlines and resting borders on chips, secondary buttons, cards. Decorative only, never the only cue.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on cream: cards, inputs, speech bubbles, unselected chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the primary pill button. Text on cream, paper, mustard and tomato (large).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and helper copy on cream or paper (5.6:1 on cream-100).

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: Brand and Blip's body. Big game moments: active path node, timer ring, lobby card. Text on it: ink at any size, cream only at 24px+.

tokens.name: tomato-deep
tokens.usage: Tomato as small text on cream or paper (4.9:1): live timer digits, warnings in copy.

tokens.name: tomato-light
tokens.usage: Blip's shine and soft tomato fills. Decorative only.

tokens.name: mustard
tokens.usage: Rewards: waves icon, sparkles, podium gold, highlight marks. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Done and correct: completed path nodes, chosen face rating border, success fills. Text on it: sage-ink.

tokens.name: sage-100
tokens.usage: Tint behind a chosen rating or a success note. Text on it: sage-ink.

tokens.name: sage-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sage and sage-100.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Selected and voice states: selected chips, voice input border, Blip's thinking dots. Text on it: lavender-ink.

tokens.name: lavender-ink
tokens.usage: Text on lavender (6.5:1).

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Blip's props only: sweat drop and tear. Never UI.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Spotlight dimmer behind Blip's coach mark.

tokens.name: blip-body
tokens.usage: Blip's body. Change here to recolor Blip everywhere.

tokens.name: blip-shine
tokens.usage: Blip's highlight crescent.

tokens.name: blip-ink
tokens.usage: Blip's eyes and mouth.

tokens.name: prop-spark
tokens.usage: Blip's sparkles.

tokens.name: prop-drop
tokens.usage: Blip's sweat drop and tear.

tokens.name: prop-dots
tokens.usage: Blip's thinking dots.

styles.name: score-xl
styles.usage: Result numbers and the end-of-session waves total. One per screen.

styles.name: game-title
styles.usage: Game names on lobby cards and round intros. Uppercase.

styles.name: game-label
styles.usage: HUD round label, podium ranks, 'I'M IN' prompt. Uppercase.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Questions and screen titles. Centered on game screens.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hold your Flow key and just talk.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: HUD text, leaderboard rows, card meta.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Fine print and tags. Never below 12px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps inside chips and pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between chips, face buttons, reply chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and the HUD bar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between stacked controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between the HUD and the play area; section rhythm.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen margins on desktop; space above primary actions.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of anything a finger presses: chips, tabs, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Face rating buttons, small tiles, inputs on mobile.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, HUD bar, result cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Lobby cards, speech bubble, play area panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, counters, any control a finger presses.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Primary pill only: a hard arcade-button lip that disappears on press.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Paper cards and Blip's bubble on cream: a flat lip, never a blur.
